40000754.author: पदार्थः
40000754.content: शर्वर्याम् when the night, प्रभातायाम् turned into day break, महामुनि: eminent ascetic, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, पर्णसंस्तरे in the bed of leaves, शयानौ lying down, काकुत्स्थौ Rama and Lakshmana, अभ्यभाषत spoke.

40000754.author: Translation
40000754.content: When the night turned into daybreak, the eminent ascetic Viswamitra, addressing the descendants of Kakutstha (Rama and Lakshmana) who were lying on a bed of leaves said:

40000755.author: पदार्थः
40000755.content: कैसल्या सुप्रजा: OBeloved son of Kausalya, (a son by whom Kausalya became a blessed mother), राम ORama, पूर्वा सन्ध्या the daybreak, प्रवर्तते is commencing ,नरशार्दूल OBest among men, उत्तिष्ठ awake (fromsleep), दैवम् oblations to gods, आह्निकम् religious rite  to be performed every day at a fixed hour, कर्तव्यम् are required to be done.

40000755.author: Translation
40000755.content: "O beloved son of Kausalya, O Rama the day dawns. O best among men, awake, oblations to gods and other sacred rites are required to be performed".

40000756.author: पदार्थः
40000756.content: वीरौ endowed with heroism, नृपात्मजौ the two princes, तस्य ऋषे: that rishi's, परमोदारम् highly generous, वच: words, श्रुत्वा having heard, स्नात्वा having bathed, कृतोदकौ offered  oblations of waters(to Sungod standing in the water), परमम् holy, जपम् tapa, जेपतु: recited.

40000756.author: Translation
40000756.content: On hearing the very affectionate call of Viswamitra both the brave princes had their bath and offered oblations to Sungod (standing in the water) and recited the holy name of the Lord.

40000757.author: पदार्थः
40000757.content: महावीर्यौ both(brothers)exceedingly powerful, कृताह्निकौ having performed daily rites, अभिसंहृष्टौ highly energetic, तपोधनम् a sage with asceticism as wealth, विश्वामित्रम् Visvamitra, अभिवाद्य having prostrated before him with reverence, गमनाय for their onward journey, अभितस्थतु: both of them stood ready before him.

40000757.author: Translation
40000757.content: On performing the morning rites, the two highly powerful and and energetic princes stood before Viswamitra who was richly endowed with asceticism. They prostrated before him. And stood ready for their onward journey.

40000758.author: पदार्थः
40000758.content: तत: thereafter, महावीर्यौ तौ those two endowed with great prowess, प्रयातौ (they)having gone a little further, तत्र there, शुभे by the holy, सरय्वा: river Sarayu, सङ्गमे in the confluence (with river Ganga), दिव्यां divine, त्रिपथगां flowing in three branches, नदीम् river, ददृशाते saw.

40000758.author: Translation
40000758.content: Thereafter, having gone a little further both the heroic brothers looked at the confluence of holy  Sarayu with  divine Ganga divided into three branches.

40000759.author: पदार्थः
40000759.content: तत्र there, बहुवर्षसहस्राणि for many thousands of years, परमम् utmost, तप: austerities, तप्यताम् while performing austerities, अग्य्रतेजसाम् sages of topmost vital power, ऋषीणाम् of the  anchorites, पुण्यम् sacred, आश्रमपदम् hermitage.

40000759.author: Translation
40000759.content: There they saw a sacred hermitage of anchorites of great vitality performing severe austerities for thousands of years.

40000760.author: पदार्थः
40000760.content: तम् that, पुण्यम् sacred, आश्रमम् hermitage, दृष्ट्वा having seen, परमप्रीतौ exceedingly delighted, राघवौ the two princes of Raghu race, महात्मानम् illustrious sage, तं विश्वामित्रम् addressing Visvamitra, इदम् वच: these words, ऊचतु: said.

40000760.author: Translation
40000760.content: Exceedingly delighted to see the sacred hermitage, the two princes enquired from the illustrious sage Viswamitra:

40000761.author: पदार्थः
40000761.content: भगवन् O Worshipful one, अयम् this, पुण्य:आश्रम: sacred hermitage, कस्य whose, अस्मिन् in this, क: नु who indeed, पुमान् man, वसते lives, श्रोतुम् to hear, इच्छाव: we both are desirous, नौ for both of us, परम् keenly, कौतूहलं हि curiosity.

40000761.author: Translation
40000761.content: "O worshipful one, whose sacred hermitage is this? Who lives here? Indeed, we are curious to know".

40000762.author: पदार्थः
40000762.content: मुनिपुङ्गव: the foremost of sages, तयो: theirs, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रहस्य after gently smiling, अब्रवीत् said, पूर्व: in the days past, अयम् आश्रम: this heritage, यस्य whose, श्रूयताम् let it be heard.

40000762.author: Translation
40000762.content: On having heard their words, the foremost of sages gently smiled and said, "O Rama listen, who this hermitage belonged to in the past".

40000763.author: पदार्थः
40000763.content: कन्दर्प: Kandarpa also known as Manmatha, मूर्तिमान् incarnated in human form, आसीत् lived, बुधै: by the learned, काम: इति उच्यते is called Kama, दुर्मेधा: foolish minded, इह here, तपस्यन्तम् while doing penance, नियमेन in accordance with rules, समाहितम् absorbed in meditation, कृतोद्वाहम् with his newly wedded wife, समरुद्गगणम् accompanied by maruts, गच्छन्तम् wending his way, देवेशम् lord of deities, स्थाणुम् Siva, धर्षयामास opposed him, महात्मना by Lord Siva, हुङ्कृतश्च roared in menacing sound.

40000763.author: Translation
40000763.content: "Kandarpa (the god of love) once lived here in human form. He is called Kama by the learned. The wicked Kama on his way with the maruts (god of wind) insulted Siva, the god of gods, while he was absorbed in austere meditation along with his newly wedded consort. On seeing Kama Lord Siva roared at him (menacingly).

40000764.author: पदार्थः
40000764.content: कन्दर्प: Kandarpa also known as Manmatha, मूर्तिमान् incarnated in human form, आसीत् lived, बुधै: by the learned, काम: इति उच्यते is called Kama, दुर्मेधा: foolish minded, इह here, तपस्यन्तम् while doing penance, नियमेन in accordance with rules, समाहितम् absorbed in meditation, कृतोद्वाहम् with his newly wedded wife, समरुद्गगणम् accompanied by maruts, गच्छन्तम् wending his way, देवेशम् lord of deities, स्थाणुम् Siva, धर्षयामास opposed him, महात्मना by Lord Siva, हुङ्कृतश्च roared in menacing sound.

40000764.author: Translation
40000764.content: "Kandarpa (the god of love) once lived here in human form. He is called Kama by the learned. The wicked Kama on his way with the maruts (god of wind) insulted Siva, the god of gods, while he was absorbed in austere meditation along with his newly wedded consort. On seeing Kama Lord Siva roared at him (menacingly).

40000765.author: पदार्थः
40000765.content: रघुनन्दन O Descendent of Raghu, रौद्रेण with fierce, चक्षुषा (third)eye, अवदग्धस्य he was  burnt down, दुर्मते: of the evil intentioned Kama, स्वात् from his own, शरीरात् body, सर्वगात्राणि all the limbs, व्यशीर्यन्त were consumed.

40000765.author: Translation
40000765.content: "O descendant of Raghu, burnt down by his fierce (third) eye, all the limbs of the body of that evilminded Kama were consumed.

40000766.author: पदार्थः
40000766.content: महात्मना by that lord Siva, निर्दग्थस्य having burnt down totally, तस्य his, गात्रम् body, तत्र there, हतम् disappeared, देवेश्वरेण by the lord of devatas, क्रोधात् because of wrath, काम: Kama, अशरीर: disembodied, कृत: had been made.

40000766.author: Translation
40000766.content: Having been completely burnt down by Lord Siva, Kama's body was destroyed. Mighty angry, Siva, reduced Kama to a 'disembodied being.

40000767.author: पदार्थः
40000767.content: राघव O Rama, तदाप्रभृति from that time onwards, अनङ्ग इति as Ananga, विख्यात: had become wellknown, यत्र where, अङ्गम् body, प्रमुमोच ह he gave up, स:च that place, श्रीमान् beautiful, अङ्गविषय: Ananga desa, विख्यात: famed.

40000767.author: Translation
40000767.content: O descendant of the Raghus, from that time onwards, he was known as 'Ananga' (one without form). The  beautiful place where he gave up his body is known as Angadesa.

40000768.author: पदार्थः
40000768.content: अयम् this, तस्य his, पुण्य: holy, आश्रम: hermitage, पुरा formerly, तस्य his, शिष्या: disciples, इमे मुनय: these ascetics, नित्यम् always, धर्मपरा: righteous, तेषाम् for them, पापम् sin, न विद्यते does not accrue.

40000768.author: Translation
40000768.content: This holy hermitage belongs to Kama. These ascetics are his disciples. They are  always righteous and are free from sin.

40000769.author: पदार्थः
40000769.content: शुभदर्शन OAuspicious looking one, राम Rama, वयम् we, अद्य today, रजनीम् this night, इह here, पुण्ययो: of both the sacred, सरितो: rivers, मध्ये in the midst, वसेम shall stay, श्व: tomorrow, तरिष्यामहे cross over.

40000769.author: Translation
40000769.content: O auspiciouslooking Rama, we will stay here tonight at the confluence of both these sacred rivers (Sarayu and Ganga) and cross over Ganga tomorrow.

40000770.author: पदार्थः
40000770.content: नरोत्तम O Chief of men, सर्वे all of us, स्नाताश्च have taken bath, कृतजप्याश्च have  performed Japa (muttering god's sacred name severally), हुतहव्या: offered oblations in fire, शुचय: pure, पुण्यम् pious, आश्रमम् hermitage, अभिगच्छामहे  we will enter.

40000770.author: Translation
40000770.content: O best of men, after morning ablutions offering oblations to the sacred fire, all of us sanctified will enter this pious hermitage".

40000771.author: पदार्थः
40000771.content: तत्र there, तेषाम् they, संवदताम् were conversing, मुनय: ascetics, तपोदीर्घेण with their far reaching austerities, चक्षुषा vision, विज्ञाय having recognised them, परमप्रीता: immensely pleased, हर्षम् delight, आगमन् obtained.

40000771.author: Translation
40000771.content: As they were conversing thus, the ascetics, with their far reaching spiritual vision (beyond the veil of time) recognised them and were immensely pleased.

40000772.author: पदार्थः
40000772.content: अर्घ्यम् respectable offerings, पाद्यम् water for washing feet, तथा and, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, कुशिकात्मजे to Visvamitra, निवेद्य having offered, पश्चात् thereafter, रामलक्ष्मणयो: for Rama and Lakshmana, अतिथिक्रियाम् acts of hospitality, अकुर्वन् performed.

40000772.author: Translation
40000772.content: After extending hospitality to the son of Kusika (Viswamitra) with respectful offerings, and water for washing feet they played the host to Rama and Lakshmana.

40000773.author: पदार्थः
40000773.content: सत्कारम् hospitality, समनुप्राप्य having received, कथाभि: with their conversation, अभिरञ्जयन् delighted, ते ऋषय: those rishis, समाहिता: with composed minds, यथार्हम् in accordance with tradition, सन्ध्याम् evening prayers, अजपन् recited.

40000773.author: Translation
40000773.content: Having received due hospitality, they delighted them (ascetics) with their talk. The rishis with composed minds recited their evening prayer as usual.

40000774.author: पदार्थः
40000774.content: तत्र there, वासिभि: by the residents, सुव्रतै: by those faithful to their vows, मुनिभि: ascetics, सह along with them, आनीता: having been brought, तदा then, तत्र there, कामाश्रमपदे in Kama's hermitage, सुसुखम् happily, न्यवसन् dwelt .

40000774.author: Translation
40000774.content: The ascetics who resided there, faithful to their vows, took them in. There they staed happily  in Kama's hermitage.

40000775.author: पदार्थः
40000775.content: धर्मात्मा the magnanimous, मुनिपुङ्गव: foremost of ascetics, कौशिक: son of Kusika, अभिरामौ charming, नृपात्मजौ princes, अभिरामाभि: by enchanting, कथाभि: tales, रमयामास delighted them.

40000775.author: Translation
40000775.content: Foremost among the ascetics the son of Kusika (Viswamitra) delighted the charming  princes with enchanting tales. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे त्रयोविंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the twentythird sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
